item.title: Geneva opens playoffs Saturday at Dallas Christian
item.description: Geneva School of Boerne, 9-1, opens the TAPPS playoffs Saturday at 2 p.m. against district champion Dallas Christian, 8-2, at Wheeler Field in Mesquite.

item.title: Boerne Champion and Boerne High sweep into third round
item.description: Boerne Champion swept Medina Valley and Boerne High swept Fox Tech in second-round volleyball Tuesday, sending both Boerne ISD teams into the third round.

item.title: Neal McCoy to headline Center benefit concert Saturday
item.description: Neal McCoy headlines The Center's Starry Night benefit concert Saturday, November 7, at Estancia at Thunder Valley, with proceeds supporting Meals on Wheels and other programs for older adults in Kendall County.

item.title: Kendall County election results (unofficial)
item.description: Unofficial Kendall County results, updated through the night

item.title: Comfort's freethinkers cenotaph was dedicated 24 years ago
item.description: On November 2, 2002, a limestone cenotaph honoring Comfort's founding freethinkers was dedicated on High Street, ending a five-year monument controversy. 24th anniversary.

item.title: Greyhounds clinch district title, Chargers lock up second place
item.description: Boerne High beat New Braunfels 28-17 on October 30 to clinch the District 13-5A Division II title, and Boerne Champion beat McCallum 61-0 the same night to finish second in District 13-5A Division I and earn a home playoff game.

item.title: Water Watch: Kendall County water status, November 2026
item.description: Kendall County stays at Stage 2 drought restrictions, Boerne stays at Stage 2, and Canyon Lake eased to 907.24 feet and 96.2 percent full.

item.title: November on the Mile: Diva Night and Handmade Market Lead the Month
item.description: November on the Hill Country Mile opens with Fall Diva Night on November 5 and the Boerne Handmade Market on November 6-7, followed by Pink Friday on November 20 and Dickens on Main on November 27-28.

item.title: Most Read on The Kendall Wire: October 2026
item.description: October's five most engaged Wire stories on Facebook, led by the Bravo reality series set in Boerne, with 159 reactions, comments, and shares combined.

item.title: Geneva Volleyball Wins Regional Title, Advances to State
item.description: Geneva School of Boerne won the regional volleyball title Saturday in San Marcos and advances to the TAPPS state tournament, while Boerne ISD playoff action continues Tuesday.

item.title: Boerne's first true public school opened 149 years ago
item.description: On November 1, 1877, the public free school of Boerne commenced at the schoolhouse, after decades of private lessons and a statewide fight over tax-supported schools. 149th anniversary.

item.title: Theatre Director Crowley Steps Down December 31
item.description: Christine Crowley steps down as executive director of the Boerne Community Theatre on December 31, after nine years in the role and 25 years with the theatre.

item.title: Comfort And Geneva Win Friday Night Finals
item.description: Comfort beat Young Men's Leadership Academy 73-6 at home and Geneva School of Boerne won 45-21 at St. Francis Episcopal in Houston on Friday, October 30.

item.title: City Leaders Deliver State Of City
item.description: Boerne Mayor Frank Ritchie, Mayor Pro Tem Ty Wolosin and City Manager Ben Thatcher gave the State of the City address October 29, covering the city budget, public safety, a sidewalk grant, Fire Station No. 2 and the Adler Road project.

item.title: Greyhounds and Chargers Both Win: Friday Night Finals, October 30
item.description: Boerne Greyhounds beat New Braunfels 28-17 and Champion Chargers beat McCallum 61-0 on Friday night, October 30.

item.title: Early Voting Day Eleven: Thursday Draws 1,277 Voters
item.description: Thursday, October 29 drew 1,277 in-person early voters in Kendall County, bringing the 11-day in-person total to 17,262, which the county puts at 41.79 percent turnout.

item.title: This Weekend in Boerne and Kendall County: October 30 to November 1
item.description: Weekend roundup for Boerne and Kendall County, Friday, October 30 to Sunday, November 1: 27 events, from Halloween festivals and trunk-or-treats to the German Motor Gathering and the farmers market.

item.title: Mail Ballots Accepted Rise to 848 in Kendall County
item.description: Kendall County reports 848 accepted mail ballots for the November 3 election, up 10 from the prior total, while the in-person early voting total stands at 14,614 through October 27.

item.title: No Hallmark Movie For Boerne
item.description: Boerne was one of 25 finalists for Hallmark's America's Merriest Christmas Town, but the title went to Carlinville, Illinois, which will be the backdrop of a 2027 Hallmark Christmas movie.

item.title: Early Voting Day Nine: Tuesday Draws 1,528 Voters
item.description: Tuesday, October 27 drew 1,528 in-person early voters in Kendall County, bringing the nine-day in-person total to 14,614, which the county puts at 35.38 percent turnout.
